scope_note: Five-crate workspace scope: noble-kernel, noble-contracts, noble-wasm, noble-cli and noble-syndicate on x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu. This records native Rust and dependency scope, not whole-program soundness or Wasm runtime correspondence. Owned WAT assets and Node/wasm-tools/Binaryen subprocesses are separately byte-bound by tool selection; their semantics are unproved and are not Rust inventory subjects or native linked dependencies. The independent Wasmtime verification peers are separate Cargo workspaces, with the M8 peer's external Cargo lock derived exactly from the reviewed M7 peer lock and selected source/vendor NAR identities. Engine behavior, native resource lifetime and host credential provenance remain explicit assumptions, not production dependency or unsafe-code discharge.
